licenses.text:
Louis Segond 1910, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/fraLSG/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/fraLSG/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in French, Louis Segond version of 1910
> Public Domain
> Language: français (French)
> Translation by: Louis Segond
> Contributor: Public Domain
> The first edition of the Bible Segond was published in 1910
> Cette Bible est dans le domaine public. Il n'est pas protégé par copyright.
> This Bible is in the Public Domain. It is not copyrighted.
> 2026-10-13

What was found:
Text: Louis Segond's Bible (Segond died 1885, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Segond) in the British and Foreign Bible Society's revised edition, "Nouvelle édition revue avec parallèles", Paris, 58 rue de Clichy, 1910. Its foreword says only that "plusieurs pasteurs et professeurs de théologie de France et de Suisse" proposed the changes, and it names no reviser (scan of the 1910 printing, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:La_Sainte_Bible,_trad._Segond,_ed._1910.djvu, pages 1-3, transcribed at https://fr.wikisource.org/wiki/Page:La_Sainte_Bible,_trad._Segond,_ed._1910.djvu/3). Genesis 1:1-12 and Matthew 1:17-2:1 in eBible's text match that scan word for word (scan pages 7 and 795). A text revised by an unnamed committee and published before 1926 is an anonymous work, in the public domain everywhere, and its translator died in 1885, so the text is in the public domain in the United States and in France. The read-aloud archive holds only the canonical verse text, chapter by chapter. Its front file says "All footnotes, introductions, and verse numbers have been stripped out", and no introduction, section heading or cross-reference from eBible's other formats appears in it. The modern book introductions of those other formats are therefore not part of this source.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=fraLSG), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/fraLSG/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Segond; https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bible_Segond; https://ebible.org/fraLSG/GEN01.htm.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
